name: Cockpit Board Companion
author: André Conde
description: Read-only Omarchy companion for the Obsidian cockpit-board plugin: a week-first schedule expandable to the full month, the selected day's tasks in cockpit-board order with expandable note bodies, overdue tasks, configurable checklist progress meters, and a task-attached pomodoro timer that stays hidden while idle. Never writes to the vault.

barWidget.description: Read-only companion for the Obsidian cockpit-board plugin, showing its task vault on a week-first schedule with per-day tasks, overdue badge, checklist meters, and a task-attached pomodoro timer.

schema.label: cockpit-board vault folder
schema.description: Vault root containing the cockpit-board task files in Tasks/Active. The plugin only ever reads it.

schema.label: Checklist meters (filename patterns)
schema.description: Comma-separated filename globs matched in Tasks/Active (e.g. "weekly-review*,launch-plan"; .md is implied). Each pattern shows a checkbox progress meter for its newest matching cockpit-board task file. Empty hides the section.

schema.label: Auto-close panel after inactivity (seconds)
schema.description: Closes an unattended panel before the shell's 150s idle screensaver can fire while it holds keyboard focus.

schema.label: Pomodoro work minutes (fallback)
schema.description: Used only when the vault's cockpit-board pomodoro settings cannot be read.

schema.label: Pomodoro break minutes (fallback)
schema.description: Used only when the vault's cockpit-board pomodoro settings cannot be read.
